edges.label: NIDS headquarters 1995-2004
edges.note: The National Institute for Discovery Science was established in 1995 by Robert T. Bigelow, described in contemporary reporting as a Las Vegas-based millionaire philanthropist and real estate developer, and it investigated both aerial phenomena and the survival of consciousness after death, running a reporting hotline and commissioning veterinary necropsies on animal-mutilation reports. It is the direct institutional predecessor of the BAASS staffing that later executed AAWSAP. Tier 2: the source places Bigelow in Las Vegas rather than stating NIDS's own registered address.
